name: own-proposal-objection

finding.title: Timeout floor overrides a configured value
finding.description: `Math.max(..., 1000)` raises any configured timeout below one second to 1000 ms, so a user who sets `timeoutMs: 200` silently gets a slower timeout than asked for.
finding.suggestedFix: Honour the configured value: `const timeoutMs = Number(config.timeoutMs) || 1000;`

priorRound.title: A zero timeout makes every request fail at once
